title: ROTH IRA INCOME LIMITS: 6 THINGS TO KNOW
series_label: ROTH IRA INCOME LIMITS (2026): 6 THINGS TO KNOW

concepts.title: The 2026 Numbers
concepts.body: In 2026 you can contribute the full $7,500 to a Roth IRA ($8,600 at 50+ with catch-up). The 2026 401(k) elective deferral limit is $24,500 ($32,500 at 50+). The two caps are separate — you can max both if you have the earned income.

concepts.title: MAGI Is The Gate
concepts.body: Eligibility runs on Modified Adjusted Gross Income, not your salary. MAGI is your AGI plus add-backs — mainly foreign earned income exclusion, foreign housing amounts, and excluded income from Puerto Rico or American Samoa. For most people, MAGI equals AGI.

visual_spec.callout_text: MAGI ≈ AGI for most people. Pre-tax 401(k) contributions lower MAGI; a year-end bonus can push you over a threshold even if base salary is under it.

concepts.title: The Phase-Out Ramp
concepts.body: The phase-out is a ramp, not a cliff. Below the floor you get the full amount; inside, your limit shrinks proportionally; at or above the top, you get zero. Single window: $153K to $168K. Joint window: $242K to $252K. Married-separate: $0 to $10K.

concepts.title: The Phase-Out Math
concepts.body: The IRS formula is proportional: (top of range − your MAGI) ÷ range size × the limit. Single at $160,500: ($168,000 − $160,500) ÷ $15,000 × $7,500 = $3,750 allowed. Joint at $247,000: same idea, $5,000 ÷ $10,000 × $7,500 = $3,750.

concepts.title: Over The Top? 3 Options
concepts.body: Above $168K single or $252K joint, you can't contribute directly — but Roth-style saving isn't over. Backdoor Roth: contribute to a traditional IRA, convert to Roth. Max the 401(k) ($24,500, no income cap). Or use a taxable brokerage for overflow — no MAGI test, same low-cost funds.

left_points: Taxable brokerage: no limits, no MAGI test
right_points: Conversion is taxable on pre-tax dollars

concepts.title: Inside The Window
concepts.body: The partial still compounds. At 7% for 30 years, $3,750/year grows to roughly $354,000 — half the ~$708,000 from a full $7,500 (hypothetical, constant return). The window is narrow: a $5,000 raise inside the $15K single window cuts a third of your allowed amount.

visual_spec.callout_text: Single partial example: $3,750/yr × 30 yr at 7% → ~$354,000. Half the contribution, half the outcome. Estimate MAGI in the fall — a bonus can still push you into the window with time to adjust.

sources_footer: Sourced from IRS IR-2025-111, IRS Notice 2025-111, IRS Publication 590-A (MAGI + conversion rules)
